Supported formats

← Back to contents

Formats you can create

FormatNotes
7zBest ratio; AES-256 and file-name encryption
zipMost compatible; legacy ZipCrypto or AES encryption
tarPacks without compressing, usually paired with the next one
xz / gzip / bzip2General single-stream formats
zstd / lz4 / brotli / lzip / snappyAdded by this port — see below
isoOptical disc image (ISO 9660 + Joliet, so non-ASCII names survive)
dmgmacOS disk image (UDZO, written through the system's hdiutil)

Formats this port added

Upstream 7-Zip 26.03 has gaps in these places. This port fills them, and in every case both creating and extracting work:

FormatUpstreamHere
zstddecode onlycreate + extract
lz4not supportedcreate + extract
brotlinot supportedcreate + extract
lzipnot supportedcreate + extract
snappynot supportedcreate + extract
isoread onlycreate
dmgread onlycreate
The format popup shows the format name while the file name uses the customary suffix: zstd → .zst, lzip → .lz, snappy → .sz. Both spellings are accepted when opening. brotli has no magic number, so it is recognised by the .br suffix alone.
A single-stream format holds one file at a time. gzip, bzip2, xz, zstd, lz4, brotli, lzip and snappy are single-stream formats; offering them several files is refused outright rather than silently compressing only the first (matching the official command-line tool). Use 7z, zip or tar to pack many files.

Formats you can read

Beyond the above, this reads rar (including RAR5), cab, wim, cpio, ar, lzh, msi, nsis, chm, dmg, iso and several dozen more, plus nearly every common single-stream format. To see exactly what the engine registers on this machine, run Test Archive and read the log drawer.

7-Zip on the command line

The installer also provides a 7zz command-line tool at /usr/local/bin/7zz, with completions for zsh, bash and fish.

That tool is deliberately left exactly as upstream ships it: it does not contain the formats added above, so 7zz a -tzstd or -tiso reports an unsupported method and exits. Keeping it untouched means an upstream upgrade needs no changes to its makefiles. The added formats exist only in the graphical app.

About RAR

The RAR decompression code comes from RARLAB's unRAR sources and, under its licence, may be used for extraction only. This app does not create RAR archives and offers no such option. The full terms are in /usr/local/share/doc/7zip/unRarLicense.txt.
